name: ClickHouse
label: ClickHouse HTTP — SQL and ping
description: Official ClickHouse HTTP interface. Default origin http://localhost:8123 (edit api_spec.baseUrl for Cloud, typically https://<host>:8443). GET /?query= (readonly), POST /?query= INSERT with JSONEachRow body, GET /ping. HTTP Basic user+password. Docs: https://clickhouse.com/docs/interfaces/http
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. execute.sql and insert.rows take official HTTP query parameters (query, database, query_id, session_id, wait_end_of_query, default_format). insert.rows also requires rows (JSONEachRow NDJSON). ping needs none. Do not put password here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP call to run. EXACT: execute.sql | insert.rows | ping. Example: execute.sql.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Official `query` URL parameter: the SQL text. execute.sql: readonly SELECT/SHOW (GET). insert.rows: INSERT INTO table FORMAT JSONEachRow (POST body is `rows`). Example: INSERT INTO events FORMAT JSONEachRow.

schema.label: rows
schema.description: insert.rows request body. Official JSONEachRow: one JSON object per line (NDJSON), not a JSON array. https://clickhouse.com/docs/interfaces/formats/JSONEachRow Example: {"id":1}\n{"id":2}.

schema.label: database
schema.description: Official `database` URL parameter: default database for the query. Example: default. Used by execute.sql and insert.rows. Falls back to config database.

schema.label: query_id
schema.description: Official `query_id` URL parameter (any string). Used to identify or replace a running query. Example: ingest-42. execute.sql and insert.rows.

schema.label: session_id
schema.description: Official `session_id` URL parameter for sticky HTTP sessions. Example: etl-session-1. execute.sql and insert.rows.

schema.label: wait_end_of_query
schema.description: Official `wait_end_of_query` URL parameter. 1 waits until the query finishes before responding. Example: 1. insert.rows and execute.sql.

schema.label: default_format
schema.description: Official `default_format` URL parameter when SQL has no FORMAT clause. Example: JSONEachRow. execute.sql and insert.rows.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider body (JSON if parseable, else text such as ping Ok.).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | insert.rows | ping.

configurationParameters.label: User
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic username. Default ClickHouse user is often 'default'. Not a secret.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic password (StudioQuack secret). Never log or place on INPUT. Must be non-empty; set a password on the ClickHouse user if the default is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Database
configurationParameters.description: Default ClickHouse database sent as the official `database` query parameter when INPUT database is empty. Example: default.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
